copy.blurb: For now, the model and The Market agree on Czechia versus Mexico to within a point on every side — and 'for now' is the operative phrase. The inputs that usually separate two numbers — the confirmed eleven, fresh injury and fitness news, weather at the venue — haven't landed yet, so today there's nothing pulling the prior away from the price. That makes Pass the correct read today, not a permanent one. The model's three-way (28% / 25% / 47%) sits on top of the market's shape. The engine refreshes as kickoff nears; if news moves enough of the prior, this can turn into a Pick. Until then, there's no gap to show.
drivers: Model and market sit within a percentage point on every side.
No real disagreement to publish — both are pricing the same shape.
Form, the confirmed line-ups, and weather get weighed closer to kickoff.
copy.summary: The model and The Market land within a point of each other on all three sides of Czechia v Mexico. No gap to publish — the state reads Pass.
